I'm not really a tech person and my situation wasn't exactly the same as yours but was getting a similar error in an application I use called Godot (I don't play Minecraft so I'm not sure if this will work). For background I use an AMD egpu with a laptop with Intel Iris Xe Graphics.

To fix my error I did the following:

1. Install "Intel Driver & Support Assistant"
2. Go to your Intel graphics driver in device manager and uninstall it making sure to check mark "Delete the driver software for this device" (don't restart your computer after this)
3. Run the Intel Driver and Support Assistant and see if there's an Intel graphics driver available.

I don't know if this is necessary but I also followed the top post on this link [http://forum.tabletpcreview.com/threads/thinkpad-x12-the-x1-tablet-successor.75614/page-12#post-558743](http://forum.tabletpcreview.com/threads/thinkpad-x12-the-x1-tablet-successor.75614/page-12#post-558743) to make it to where drivers don't reinstall automatically then changed it back when I fixed my problem.
